headline: Nike Co-Founder Phil Knight Pledges $1.1B to Oregon Medical Center
meta_description: Nike co-founder Phil Knight commits $1.1 billion to support an Oregon medical center, marking a major philanthropic gift for healthcare.
summary_short: Nike co-founder Phil Knight is donating $1.1 billion to an Oregon medical center, one of the largest recent gifts to American healthcare.
body:
Nike co-founder Phil Knight is donating $1.1 billion to an Oregon medical center. The gift represents a major philanthropic commitment to expanding healthcare access in the region.

Knight's contribution underscores the growing role of private philanthropy in strengthening medical institutions. For Oregon, the donation signals a significant boost to local healthcare infrastructure and capacity.
quick_facts: Phil Knight, Nike co-founder, donating $1.1 billion
Recipient is an Oregon-based medical center
One of largest recent healthcare donations
